title: Five Exact Spots Where Gravity Balances

segments.text: Did you know there are exactly five cosmic parking spots for any two‑body dance?
Every two‑body system has five Lagrange points, labeled L1 through L5.
L1, L2 and L3 lie on the straight line joining the two massive bodies.
L4 and L5 each sit at the third vertex of an equilateral triangle with the two bodies.
In the Sun‑Earth system, L1 and L2 sit about 1.5 million km from Earth, far beyond the Moon’s orbit.
Those five exact spots are where gravity and motion balance.

question: Which of these balance points might behave differently with another planet nearby?
